_comment: v13 grid — 3 exit bugs fixed. stoploss widened so custom_stoploss controls R:R. ml_exit_threshold raised so winners aren't cut prematurely.

_grid_rationale.stoploss: Bug A fix: must be wider than max ATR stop (-1.5*2.5%=-3.75%) so custom_stoploss always fires first. -0.08/-0.10/-0.12 all qualify.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: Entry proba threshold for long+short. Bear branch auto-tightens to +0.05.
_grid_rationale.ml_exit_threshold: Bug C fix: raised from [0.40,0.45,0.50] to [0.60,0.65,0.70]. Old 0.45 cut winners at <1% gain. Now requires high reversal confidence to exit.

_bugs_fixed_v13.B: minimal_roi in strategy changed to {0:0.99} — disabled. custom_stoploss trail owns all exits.
_bugs_fixed_v13.C: ml_exit_threshold default raised from 0.45 to 0.65 in strategy + grid sweep
